text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you hear...? Apparently, someone 
in the class next door got a piece of lint 
taken out of their hair by Miracle-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I saw that...! And you fixed your hair 
while you were at it. That's just like 
you, Senpai~

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
She might not have that explosive, 
mainstream popularity, but Miracle-senpai 
is just so great... Ehehe, I'll keep 
secretly cheering her on...âª

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was that the voice of an underclassman? It 
seems K.S. Miracle is secretly quite 
popular among the juniors...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my way back to the trainer's office, I 
saw a student carrying a large stack of 
documents.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa-whoa... Ah! E-Eeeek!?
Whoops...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? H-Huh... it doesn't... hurt...?

...Can you stand? Watch your step. Take 
your time, okay?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: E-Eeeek!? M-Miracle-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"...Y-Yes! Thanks to you, just look at 
me...!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Thank goodness. I'm so glad you're not 
hurt, really.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
M-Miracle-senpai...! Ah! I-I'm so sorry! 
Sorry for causing you trouble...!
choice_data_list:
Glad you made it in time. That was 
magnificent!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Y-You're exaggerating.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, that's right. Isn't that luggage a 
bit heavy? If you'd like, let me carry 
some.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Huh...! Th... Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the three of us divided up the 
luggage and finished carrying it.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Senpai, thank you for everything! You even 
helped carry my bags...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No. If there's ever anything else I can 
help with, please don't hesitate to ask. 
Just don't push yourself too hard like 
before. ...Okay?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Hyai... I'll be careful next time! 
...Excuse me, then!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ......No. ...Sorry, hold on.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure you didn't sprain your leg? 
You're walking a bit strangely...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? —No, I'm okay! It just feels a 
little strange, but there's no pain.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...No. Even so, let's head to the 
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hold onto my shoulder. Don't hesitate, you 
can lean on me for support, okay?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Hyah...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: W-W-Whoa... T-Too close...!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Doctor, could you take a look 
at her leg? It looks like she sprained it 
a little earlier.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? Is your face red...? Maybe we should 
have your temperature taken, too...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
N-No... t-this is...! I-I'm fine on my own 
now! Thank you so muchhh!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah, wait a second...!?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I-Is everything going to be okay...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Huh, Trainer...? W-What's the matter?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt like I understood why K.S.Miracle 
has so many fans among the underclassmen. 
Be that as it may...
choice_data_list:
You showed up to save me at incredible 
speed!

You showed up to save me at incredible 
speed, huh!

has so many fans among the underclassmen. 
Be that as it may...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Right after a shock, people sometimes 
don't notice right away when something 
feels off. So I was keeping a close eye on 
you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
When I think about what would have 
happened if I'd kept training like that... 
...I'm so glad I realized it in time. 
Truly.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I just happened to be passing by... and 
when I thought it looked dangerous, my 
feet just started moving on their own."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"To tell the truth, my heart was pounding 
like crazy back then. It really was down 
to the wire... Phew... I'm so glad I made 
it in time..."
